class.name: NetwLifecycleRequest
class.brief_description: A controller's spawn, despawn or move of an entity, waiting for the server's verdict.
class.description: [NetwLifecycleRequest] is emitted, on the server only, by [signal NetwEntity.lifecycle_requested] with one [NetwLifecycleRequest] per change the [member NetwEntity.controller] of a [constant NetwEntity.LIFECYCLE_CONTROLLER] entity makes. The server may call [method deny] before the change reaches any other peer. [codeblock] func _on_lifecycle_requested(peer_id: int, request: NetwLifecycleRequest) -> void: if request.kind == NetwLifecycleRequest.KIND_DESPAWN and not may_remove(peer_id): request.deny("only the builder removes it") [/codeblock] The denial latches. A later [method deny] or a write of [code]false[/code] to [member denied] changes nothing, so listener order does not matter. The peer that made the change hears of it in [signal NetwEntity.lifecycle_refused], with the [member reason] the first [method deny] gave.

method.name: deny
method.description: Refuses this change and records [param reason] for the peer that made it. Only the first call counts.

members.member: Whether the change is refused. Writing [code]false[/code] over a [method deny] call has no effect.
The parent the entity is placed under, or [code]null[/code] for [constant KIND_DESPAWN]. On a spawn it is the handler's way into the world, because [member entity] has not entered the tree.
The entity the change is about. On a spawn it is the server's copy, holding the values the controller sent.
What the server passed to [method deny], empty until then.
The peer id of the controller that made the change.

constants.constant: The controller spawned the entity with [method Netw.spawn], [method Netw.replicate] or [method NetwEntity.spawn_under].
The controller despawned the entity with [method Netw.despawn] or [method NetwEntity.despawn].
The controller moved the entity with [method Netw.reparent] or [method Node.reparent].
